question: Should OpenClaw sponsor official FreeBSD support, and if so should it be community/experimental support or Tier 1 release support?
rationale: The request changes the product support contract across packaging, docs, service lifecycle, CI, release validation, and long-term ownership; code inspection shows no narrow missing API or one-file bugfix that would safely settle that direction.

options.title: Define community FreeBSD scope
options.body: Recognize FreeBSD as community or experimental until owners, docs, service behavior, upgrade tracking, and release smoke expectations are named.

options.title: Promote toward Tier 1
options.body: Accept ongoing FreeBSD release ownership and open tracked implementation work for pkg/ports coordination, service management, CI, docs, and validation.

options.title: Decline official support
options.body: Leave FreeBSD as external/community packaging and close the support-tier request after documenting that policy.

recommendation.title: Define community FreeBSD scope
recommendation.body: Recognize FreeBSD as community or experimental until owners, docs, service behavior, upgrade tracking, and release smoke expectations are named.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily support-tier and roadmap scope, and CONTRIBUTING.md lists steipete as the project lead.
